name: data.redis
doc:
data.redis: a Redis client written in Zell over net and
net.tls (docs/STDLIB.md level 3b). Four files share the namespace:

  redis.zl          RESP2/RESP3 codec (Reply), Options and URLs,
                    connections (handshake: HELLO / AUTH / SELECT) and
                    the connection pool (health checks, lifetime, waits
                    with a timeout and cancellation)
  redis_client.zl   Client and the typed command set (Cmds), pipelines,
                    MULTI/EXEC transactions with WATCH, Lua scripts,
                    pub/sub subscriptions
  redis_route.zl    the router behind a Client: one server, Sentinel
                    (master discovery, +switch-master, replicas) or
                    Cluster (slot map, MOVED/ASK, hash tags), retries

Errors: a server error reply is an Error{Code, Text} ("WRONGTYPE ...");
a missing value is the sentinel Nil (errors.Is(err, redis.Nil)); network
errors are those of net. The sentinels Nil, ErrClosed, ErrTxFailed,
ErrPoolTimeout and ErrCrossSlot are compiler constants (sema/stdlib.rs,
runtime/src/std_infra.c).

items.name: ParseURL
items.doc:
Parses redis://[[user]:password@]host[:port][/db][?options],
rediss://... (TLS) or unix:///path/to/socket[?db=N&...]. Options:
db, protocol, client_name, dial_timeout, read_timeout, pool_size,
pool_timeout, idle_check, max_conn_age, max_retries (durations as
"500ms", "5s" or seconds), and for rediss skip_verify=true.
items.summary: Parses redis://[[user]:password@]host[:port][/db][?options], rediss://...

members.name: Watch
members.signature: func Watch(keys []string, fn func(*Tx) Task<void!>) Task<void!>
members.doc:
Optimistic locking: WATCH keys on one connection, run fn with a Tx
on it, then UNWATCH. Inside fn, read with tx.Get..., then queue the
writes on tx.TxPipeline() and Exec them: Exec fails with ErrTxFailed
if a watched key changed in between.
members.summary: Optimistic locking: WATCH keys on one connection, run fn with a Tx on it, then UNWATCH.

Nil) and the RESP3 additions (Map, Set, Double, Bool, BigNumber,
Verbatim, Push).
items.summary: The type of a reply: the RESP2 types (Status, Error, Int, Bulk, Array, Nil) and the RESP3 additions (Map, Set, Double, Bool, BigNumber, Verbatim, Push).

items.doc:
Options of a Client (and of each node of a Sentinel or Cluster client).
Durations are milliseconds; zero values take the defaults in brackets.
items.summary: Options of a Client (and of each node of a Sentinel or Cluster client).

members.summary: host:port [localhost:6379], or a Unix socket path when Network is "unix"

members.summary: connections per server [10]

members.summary: waiting for a free connection [ReadTimeout + 1000, at least 4000]

idle connections older than this are checked with PING before use

items.name: Pipeline
items.doc:
Queued commands (Client.Pipeline / TxPipeline, Tx.TxPipeline). Each
command method returns a task that completes when Exec has run; Exec
itself yields every reply (a server error as an Error reply) and fails
only when the round trip fails, or with ErrTxFailed when a WATCHed key
changed. Call Exec or Discard: queued tasks wait until then.
items.summary: Queued commands (Client.Pipeline / TxPipeline, Tx.TxPipeline).

members.name: Exec
members.doc: Sends the queued commands in one round trip.
members.summary: Sends the queued commands in one round trip.

members.name: Discard
members.doc: Drops the queued commands (their tasks fail).
members.summary: Drops the queued commands (their tasks fail).

members.name: Len
members.doc: The number of queued commands.
members.summary: The number of queued commands.

items.name: PoolStats
items.doc: Pool statistics of a Client (summed over its servers).
items.summary: Pool statistics of a Client (summed over its servers).

members.name: Hits

members.summary: connections handed out from the idle list / newly dialed

members.name: Timeouts
members.doc: waits for a free connection that timed out
members.summary: waits for a free connection that timed out

members.name: StaleConns

members.summary: idle connections closed by the health check or MaxConnAge

items.name: Reply
items.doc:
One reply. Str holds the text of Status, Error, Bulk, Verbatim (without
its "txt:" format prefix) and BigNumber replies; Int an Int (and a Bool
as 0/1); Float a Double; Elems the elements of an Array, Set or Push,
and of a Map as key, value, key, value...
items.summary: One reply.

members.name: Err
members.doc: The error of an Error reply (nil otherwise).
members.summary: The error of an Error reply (nil otherwise).

members.name: Text
members.doc:
The reply as text: Status, Bulk, Verbatim, BigNumber, Int and Double
(formatted); Nil fails with redis.Nil, an Error reply with its error.
members.summary: The reply as text: Status, Bulk, Verbatim, BigNumber, Int and Double (formatted); Nil fails with redis.Nil, an Error reply with its error.

members.summary: The reply as an integer (an Int, a Bool, or a numeric string).

members.name: Number

members.summary: The reply as a float (a Double, an Int or a numeric string).

members.name: Boolean

members.summary: The reply as a boolean: Bool, Int (non-zero), Status "OK".

members.name: Values

members.summary: The elements of an Array, Set, Push or Map (flattened); Nil gives none.

members.name: Strings

members.summary: The elements as strings (nil elements become "").

members.summary: A Map reply, or an Array of key, value pairs (RESP2), as a map.

members.summary: A Map reply (or Array of pairs) as a map of replies.

members.name: String

members.summary: The reply as redis-cli would show it (for logs and tests).

ends the iteration; Err() tells why.

items.name: Subscription
items.doc:
A subscription on its own connection. Messages are queued (up to 1024;
more are dropped and counted) and read with Receive or `for msg in sub`
(ends when the subscription is closed). A lost connection is redialed
and every channel and pattern subscribed again.
items.summary: A subscription on its own connection.

members.doc: Subscribe subscribes to channels and waits for the server's confirmation.
members.summary: Subscribe subscribes to channels and waits for the server's confirmation.

members.name: PSubscribe
members.doc: PSubscribe subscribes to glob patterns of channels.
members.summary: PSubscribe subscribes to glob patterns of channels.

members.name: Unsubscribe
members.doc: Unsubscribe unsubscribes from channels (an empty list does nothing).
members.summary: Unsubscribe unsubscribes from channels (an empty list does nothing).

members.name: PUnsubscribe
members.doc: PUnsubscribe unsubscribes from patterns (an empty list does nothing).
members.summary: PUnsubscribe unsubscribes from patterns (an empty list does nothing).

members.name: Receive
members.doc:
The next message; fails with ErrClosed once the subscription is
closed and its queue drained.
members.summary: The next message; fails with ErrClosed once the subscription is closed and its queue drained.

members.name: Next
members.doc: The iteration protocol.
members.summary: The iteration protocol.

members.summary: The channel the messages are queued on.

members.name: Channels

members.name: Patterns

members.doc:
Closes the connection; queued messages can still be read, then the
iteration ends. The task completes when the reader has stopped.
members.summary: Closes the connection; queued messages can still be read, then the iteration ends.
